defect.summary: When a capped run switched from the estimate meter to a real meter, newEpoch closed the estimate epoch with zero usage, so tokens already settled against the estimate were dropped from the carried total and the run under-counted its spend.

severity.basis: The fix adds a regression test ('estimate spend survives a change of meter (estimate -> capy -> estimate)') that the old line fails, and the lost spend is ledger data loss that weakens the cap.
